realm_description: The coastline where continents first meet the wider world. Every citizen's story starts here, pulled outward by trade, curiosity, and the promise of connection.

primary.label: Navigator
primary.description: Reads currents no one else notices; calculates the way through when the group panics.
primary.guiding_promise: I will find the true course, even when the stars are hidden.
primary.shadow_description: Trusts only their own reading of the current, and stops listening for anyone else's.

secondary.label: Explorer
secondary.description: Fears limitation more than the unknown; needs to discover.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will go where no map exists and make my own path.
secondary.shadow_description: Never stays anywhere long enough to build something that could have lasted.

wheel.central_question: Should we build relationships, or seek new horizons?

growth.label: Explorer
growth.description: Fears limitation more than the unknown; needs to discover.
growth.guiding_promise: I will go where no map exists and make my own path.
growth.shadow_description: Never stays anywhere long enough to build something that could have lasted.

other_ally.label: Survivor
other_ally.description: Endures; resilience is the value they hold above all others.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will rise from the ash, proving that our light cannot be crushed.
other_ally.shadow_description: Treats every calm moment as the quiet before the next disaster, and lets no one close enough to prove otherwise.

quarter.label: Judge
quarter.description: Weighs fairness deliberately; authority must be earned, not assumed.
quarter.guiding_promise: I hold the scale steady, even when the verdict costs me.
quarter.shadow_description: Hides behind the letter of the rule to avoid the harder, human work of mercy.

opposite.label: Diplomat
opposite.description: Builds consensus, dreads open conflict more than slow progress.
opposite.guiding_promise: I build bridges where others build walls.
opposite.shadow_description: Smooths over a rupture that needed to be named, and calls the silence peace.

wheel.compatible_text: Diplomat · Messenger — fellow travelers of The Shoreline.
